item.text: [{"task_id":"2753e76c","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    unit = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    descending = bool(int(round(params['rule'][2])))","    align_right = bool(int(round(params['rule'][3])))","    offsets = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['neighbors']]","    h, w = grid.shape","    seen = set()","    counts = {}","    for r in range(h):","        for c in range(w):","            color = int(grid[r, c])","            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:","                continue","            counts[color] = counts.get(color, 0) + unit","            seen.add((r, c))","            pending = [(r, c)]","            while pending:","                y, x = pending.pop()","                for dy, dx in offsets:","                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx","                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w:","                        if (ny, nx) not in seen and int(grid[ny, nx]) == color:","                            seen.add((ny, nx))","                            pending.append((ny, nx))","    if not counts:","        return grid.copy()","    colors = list(counts)","    colors.sort(key=counts.get, reverse=descending)","    width = max(counts.values())","    if width <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    result = np.full((len(colors), width), bg, dtype=int)","    for row, color in enumerate(colors):","        amount = counts[color]","        start = width - amount if align_right else 0","        result[row, start:start + amount] = color","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[4],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"rule":[0,1,1,1],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Count connected objects of each nonbackground color, order colors by decreasing object count, and render right-aligned rows whose lengths equal those counts. The test has five color-3 objects, four color-4 objects, and two color-8 objects."}]
